stops.name: Handthal
stops.quote: In fact, a lot revolves around the liquid grape gold for this cheerful character from Handthal in Lower Franconia.
stops.english: In fact, a lot revolves around the liquid grape gold for this cheerful character from Handthal in Lower Franconia.

stops.name: Stollburg Castle
stops.quote: The “Weg der Erkenntnis” (path of knowledge) leading up to Stollburg Castle helps to combat incomplete wine knowledge.
stops.english: The “Weg der Erkenntnis” (path of knowledge) leading up to Stollburg Castle helps to combat incomplete wine knowledge.

stops.name: Ebrach monastery
stops.quote: It is also about the Cistercians who once lived in the nearby Ebrach monastery and introduced viticulture to the region.
stops.english: It is also about the Cistercians who once lived in the nearby Ebrach monastery and introduced viticulture to the region.

stops.name: Francis Trail
stops.quote: One would love to join the regular hikers passing by, be it on one of the many trails starting here or at least on the short “Francis Trail” with its thought-provoking stations such as a walk-in bee house.
stops.english: One would love to join the regular hikers passing by, be it on one of the many trails starting here or at least on the short “Francis Trail” with its thought-provoking stations such as a walk-in bee house.

stops.name: Steigerwald Centre
stops.quote: The bee house is located next to the Steigerwald Centre, the ideal starting point for any tour.
stops.english: The bee house is located next to the Steigerwald Centre, the ideal starting point for any tour.

stops.name: Steigerwald Treetop Path
stops.quote: The Steigerwald Treetop Path near Ebrach, which opened in 2016, makes a major – if not the largest – contribution to this identity.
stops.english: The Steigerwald Treetop Path near Ebrach, which opened in 2016, makes a major – if not the largest – contribution to this identity.

stops.name: Methusalempfad
stops.quote: Apt name for the three-kilometre loop: the Methuselah path, or Methusalempfad .
stops.english: Apt name for the three-kilometre loop: the Methuselah path, or Methusalempfad .
